text: On Christmas Day nineteen fifty, four students stole Britain's coronation stone. The Stone of Scone sat under the coronation chair in Westminster Abbey. They drove eighteen hours from Glasgow to London. They took it out of the Abbey and back to Scotland. It was returned to the Abbey in nineteen fifty two. Then in nineteen ninety six, it officially went home. A Christmas heist by students that Britain still talks about. Would you have pulled it off?
